title: Cardiac ICU Patient Admission Protocol
description: Standard procedure for admitting patients to the Cardiac Intensive Care Unit

steps.description: Verify physician orders and patient identification
steps.details: Review admission orders, confirm patient identity using two identifiers (name and DOB), verify diagnosis and reason for ICU admission
validation_criteria: Patient identity confirmed with two identifiers
Admission orders signed by attending physician
warnings: Do not proceed without proper identification verification

steps.details: Complete comprehensive nursing assessment including vital signs, cardiac monitoring setup, and assessment of consciousness level using Glasgow Coma Scale
validation_criteria: Cardiac monitoring active and alarms set
warnings: Alert physician immediately if vital signs are unstable

steps.description: Establish IV access and begin monitoring
steps.details: Establish or verify adequate IV access (minimum 18G for cardiac patients), connect to cardiac monitor, set appropriate alarm parameters
validation_criteria: Alarm parameters set according to patient condition

steps.details: Review medication orders, verify allergies, administer time-sensitive cardiac medications as ordered
Document all admission activities, complete required forms, update patient status in electronic health record

steps.description: Communicate with family and care team
steps.details: Update family on admission status and patient condition, notify care team members of admission
